tools.name: search_tickets
tools.description: Search helpdesk tickets by keyword and status.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Fetch the full details and history of one ticket.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.description: Change a ticket's status and add a comment.

tools.name: assign_ticket
tools.description: Assign a ticket to a technician.

tools.name: lookup_user
tools.description: Look up an employee account in the directory.

tools.description: Reset an account password and send the temporary one to a mailbox.

tools.description: Add an account to a security or licence group.

tools.description: Send an email from the helpdesk mailbox.

tools.name: search_kb
tools.description: Search the internal knowledge base articles.

tools.name: post_to_channel
tools.description: Post a message to an internal chat channel.
